_comment: ThePerch openclaw cron job template. Copy into ~/.openclaw/cron/jobs.json (merging with any existing jobs your install already has) and adjust paths/timezone. The 9 jobs below are the ones SETUP-FOR-AGENTS.md Step 13 enumerates. All use the lightContext + exec + minimax-portal/MiniMax-M2.7-highspeed + NO_REPLY pattern so the cron agent runs the script silently on success. (Earlier versions specified `zai/glm-5` here, but the openclaw gateway rejects that model with `payload.model 'zai/glm-5' not allowed, falling back to agent defaults`, breaking cron reliability — caught and fixed in the BioChecha rotation diagnostic pass.) Each payload invokes the python script directly via the set -a && source perch.env && set +a && python3 ... idiom — no separate wrapper shell scripts needed. Adjust the script root path if your openclaw workspace isn't at the default ~/.openclaw/workspace/scripts/ location.

jobs.name: oura-ingest
jobs.description: Pull Oura sleep + readiness; primary sleep source.

payload.message:
Run exactly this command once and wait for it to complete:

bash -lc 'set -a && source $HOME/.openclaw/secrets/perch.env && set +a && python3 $HOME/.openclaw/workspace/scripts/health-integrations/oura_ingest.py'

Rules:
- Do not change the command.
- If it succeeds with no output, reply exactly NO_REPLY.
- If it produces output, reply with a brief summary.
- If it fails, do not mask or summarize.
